description: Surface conditions (B-04, ADR-0017): mean temperature at the reference surface, surface pressure at a solid surface, and the pressure level of the giant planets' reference radii. From the NASA Planetary Fact Sheets (S-NSSDC-FACT, Tier 2, labeled) and, for Neptune's 1 bar level, the pinned pck00011.tpc (Tier 1). Each value is the text of its source with its unit; the pipeline converts it to K or Pa.

entries.table: Planetary Fact Sheet - Metric (last updated 18 March 2025), row 'Mean Temperature (C)', column MERCURY
entries.transcriber_note: Extracted on 2026-11-02 by a script from the cells of the downloaded page (tags removed, text kept as written) and checked against the page's table as text. The notes (planetfact_notes.html, last updated 20 December 2021): 'the average temperature over the whole planet's surface (or for the gas giants at the one bar level)'.
